title: Rav Acha of Bei Chozai
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: A precious homily of his is recorded in Gittin 7a: “Whoever has a grievance against his fellow over food and keeps silent, He who dwells in the bush executes judgment for him.” But Rav Sherira Gaon’s reading in his Epistle, part 2, end of chapter 4, is Rav Acha of Bei Chatim. Hyman identifies him as one of the Savoraim.

notes.text: Gittin 7a gives Rav Acha of Bei Chozai. In the consulted Epistle, Rav Sherira gives Bei Chatim and includes him among the Savoraim.
